discovery.summary: Check how recently authoritative RDAP says a domain record changed
discovery.description: Resolve a domain through IANA RDAP bootstrap and its authoritative registry, then compare the published last-changed event with a caller-selected recent window. Returns recently_changed, stable_since_window, unregistered, or human_review. A recent RDAP metadata change is not by itself evidence of compromise, fraud, ownership change, malicious activity, or business risk.
discovery.resource_description: Determine whether authoritative RDAP says a domain registration record changed within a caller-selected recent window. Returns recently_changed, stable_since_window, unregistered, or human_review. A recent RDAP metadata change is not by itself evidence of compromise, fraud, ownership change, malicious activity, or business risk.

buyer.task: Determine whether authoritative RDAP says a domain registration record changed within a caller-selected recent window.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure independent settled purchases and repeat buyers per product after launch; do not infer demand from tests or crawler probes.

sources.authority: IANA DNS bootstrap plus authoritative registry RDAP
sources.refresh_policy: authoritative domain lookup on each paid request
sources.cache_policy: IANA bootstrap cached in memory for adapter lifetime; authoritative domain result not cached

rules: Resolve the domain through IANA bootstrap and authoritative registry RDAP.
Return unregistered when authoritative RDAP reports the domain is not registered.
Use only the authoritative domain lastChanged event; do not substitute RDAP database-refresh timestamps.
Return recently_changed when lastChanged is on or after the recent-window cutoff; return stable_since_window when older; otherwise return human_review.

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; do not settle payment.
failure_behavior.payment_unresolved: HTTP 503; caller should retry the same payment authorization.

criteria: Release gate passes from the same registry revision.
Authoritative live-source smoke passes without source failures.
Shared non-credit-gated hosting is available and measured.
Post-allowance unit economics are settlement-negative at the current price; commercial promotion remains blocked until economics are repaired or an explicit exception is approved.
